title: DNI Anonymizer
description: Upload your DNI to blur sensitive information before sharing. Your image is processed locally in your browser and is never uploaded to any server.
hotelIntro: According to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), hotels only need to collect specific data for the traveler's entry form. They are not permitted to make a full copy of your ID.
recommendationRedact: We recommend redacting all other data, especially:
dataMrz: The MRZ (Machine Readable Zone at the bottom)
generalExampleDNIBlur: This is an example provided by the Policia Nacional on how to blur sensitive data.
generalInfoText: For more details on when it is legal to request a copy of your ID, you can consult this illustrative article.
aboutText: DNISeguro is a tool designed to protect your privacy. We want to be 100% transparent: your images are never uploaded to any server. All redaction processing happens securely and exclusively within your own browser. What happens on your computer, stays on your computer.
